name: Pendulum Lunge
how_to:
1. Starting Position: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands in front of your chest or on your hips.
2. Reverse Lunge: Step one leg backward and lower into a reverse lunge while keeping your torso upright.
3. High Knee to Forward Lunge: Push through the front foot, drive the same leg forward into a high knee, then step directly into a forward lunge.
4. Return to Start: Push back to the starting position to complete one repetition.
5. Repeat: Perform the desired reps on one leg before switching sides.
